build_tta_model: build a python module to create an AverageClsScoreTTA model for test-time augmentation in classification
merge_predictions: merge predictions from multiple augmented data samples by averaging their prediction scores
register_model: register the AverageClsScoreTTA class in the mmpretrain MODELS registry using the decorator
average_pred_scores: compute the average prediction score across all augmented versions of a single data sample
use_tta_for_classification: use test-time augmentation to improve classification accuracy by averaging scores from enhanced inputs
